source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Networking Devices' (PDF 9): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Networking devices network mein computers aur doosre devices ko jorne ke liye istemal hote hain. Yeh devices data ke flow (bahao) ko control karte hain. Communication (baat-cheet) mein har device ka apna khaas kaam (role) hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Is topic ke paanch devices: NIC (device ko network se jorta hai), switch (network ke andar sahi device tak), router (networks ko jorta hai), modem (ISP tak, signal badalta hai) aur wireless access point (Wi-Fi deta hai). Har ek agle page par hai.

blocks.prompt: Networking devices ka kaam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Computers aur doosre devices ko network mein jorna aur data ke flow ko control karna.

items: Networking devices devices ko jorte aur data ka flow control karte hain; har device ka apna kaam.
